name: How does electrical work for an addition differ from a simple room remodel?

mainEntity.name: How does electrical work for an addition differ from a simple room remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Electrical work for an addition often involves expanding your home's overall electrical capacity, potentially requiring an upgrade to your main service panel. Unlike a simple room remodel, which might primarily involve reconfiguring existing circuits, an addition means integrating entirely new circuits into your home's system. This can be more complex due to the need for new power lines from the main panel, additional grounding, and compliance with current building codes for new construction. It often results in a more extensive and potentially longer electrical phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Electrical work for an addition typically requires expanding electrical capacity and potentially upgrading the main service panel, which is more complex than a room remodel.
